mapillary/*.jpg - attribution and licence

The six JPEGs in this directory are the 2048 x 1024 thumbnails (Graph API field thumb_2048_url) of 360-degree
street-level images published on Mapillary (https://www.mapillary.com), fetched unmodified on 2026-10-28. Mapillary
publishes its imagery under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International licence (CC BY-SA 4.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). That licence covers these image files only, not the code in this
repository. They are the measurement input of tests/test_pose_levelling.py (issue #72); poses.json records each
file's sha256 and size, and the test refuses a file that does not match.
